attempts.summary: Configured node1 (10.100.19.10) as an internal DNS resolver using dnsmasq, resolving inventory-api.internal to node2 (10.100.19.11) and forwarding other queries upstream. Configured node2 via a persistent systemd-networkd drop-in (DNS=10.100.19.10, Domains=~internal, UseDNS=no) to use node1 as its resolver for internal lookups. Verified end-to-end resolution via node2's default resolver path (dig/getent/nslookup). Performed the mandatory sequential restart protocol on both nodes: captured baseline boot IDs and service health, rebooted node1 then node2 one at a time via systemctl reboot, confirmed each node's boot_id changed (proving an actual restart, not just a service bounce), and verified dnsmasq auto-started on node1 and node2's DNS config/resolution auto-recovered after reboot with no manual intervention.
